end.summary:
Practised regional diversity in dress, climate, food and festivals.
Riya identified the phiran as Kashmiri clothing suited to cold weather.
Compared Pongal and Bihu as different forms of a shared seasonal/harvest idea.
Shared values and common threads were identified in both attempts; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how regional differences in clothing and festivals can reflect climate and shared seasonal ideas. Riya explained the phiran example clearly and connected Pongal and Bihu through their harvest timing, while noting that names, foods and customs differ. Asha corrected no recorded mix-up; the exact Bihu connection remained uncertain. At home, ask Riya to make a small table with two regions, their clothing or festival, and one shared idea.
